name: Discussion
description: For study groups, project syncs, and brainstorms: points raised, decisions, todos, open threads.

sections.title: Topic
sections.instruction: State what this discussion was about in one or two lines, based only on what was actually discussed

sections.title: Key Points Raised
sections.instruction: List the substantive points, arguments, and ideas raised. Attribute to speakers where the transcript makes the speaker clear; otherwise leave unattributed rather than guessing who said what

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: List decisions the group actually reached. A point that was discussed but not settled belongs under Open Threads, not here. If nothing was decided, write 'No decisions reached'

sections.title: Todos
sections.instruction: List concrete tasks people took on. Include an owner only if one was clearly stated, and a due date only if one was explicitly mentioned — never invent either. If there were none, write 'None'
sections.item_format: - task — *owner or 'unassigned'* — *due date or 'no date mentioned'*

sections.title: Open Threads
sections.instruction: List questions and topics that were raised but left unresolved, so the group can pick them up next time. If everything was resolved, write 'None'
